releaseNotes: Themes now change the WHOLE app. 7 complete looks — Editorial, Ivory, Forest, Ocean, Plum, Midnight and Midnight Gold. Switching a theme restyles the page background, cards, sidebar, text, lines, charts and buttons on the console, and the teacher app follows the school's theme automatically. Also: cleaner filter chips on white cards, tidier attendance list, bigger mark boxes, safer cloud marks send, dead buttons now respond.
